message.content:
A typical employee would **leave the storage date unchanged, review the box as normal, and include it in the full manifest released by 13:30**, allowing it to be destroyed at 14:30.

The requested extension is only pending, and permission is not available until Tuesday’s sitting. It therefore cannot lawfully be entered today; even if granted tomorrow, it would not retroactively authorise a date change. The manager has also explicitly said there will be no discretionary extensions this cycle.

At most, the employee might document or escalate the uniqueness of the photographs and letters for attention, but they would not delay the manifest or unilaterally hold the box, because that would leave the shift incomplete and breach the instruction to release the full batch on time.
